statistical_result.cold_interpretation: Diagnostic interval on paired absolute cold differences. Broad intervals do not prove equivalence; no cold-speed claim is made.

harness_review.browser_lifetime: One Chromium browser process tree for the10runs. New context and page for eachrun, awaited context.close infinally. No forcedGC or process relaunch betweenruns.
harness_review.cache_lifetime: Application modules and caches are context-local. Everyrun actually requested theHTML,module,index,and96parts, so observed HTTPcache reuse did not eliminate files across runs. End cachecounts and bytes identical.
harness_review.server_lifetime: OneNodeHTTPserver. Each actualfile request uses fs.readFile; no explicit server bytecache. OS filecache is uncontrolled and may remain warm. Read completion and transmission timings were not separately recorded.
harness_review.retained_harness_state: Source Map holds2fixedmodulebuffers. Per-run results retain only scalars/smallobjects; latency10000array remains inside the page and is not returned. Traffic arrays append990small metadata entries over10runs; they retain no response-body buffers.
harness_review.cleanup: Every completed contextclosed sequentially after reportsaved, and final browser/serverclosed. No failureorwatchdog. Chromium/network-service/allocator internal reclamation timing and memory were not measured.
harness_review.instrumentation: No per-fetch/hash/decodewrappers. Each record usesperformance.now and compares2f64bitstrings andsuppcount, identically in bothvariants. Read-onlycache export invoked onlyaftertiming.
harness_review.server_delay_field: The near-zero server_delay_ms field begins afterfs.readFile and measures only optionalheader-delay bookkeeping. It cannot establish disk-read or response-transfer equality.

last_pair_review.inference: The557ms aggregate loss is muchlarger than the19.7ms difference in maximumrecordlatency, andp95alsoincreases. This is not evidence of one isolatedrecordoutlier. Earlierbaseline runs1and4alsohad higher broad latency; cause unmeasured.
